DIAGNOSIS: Chronic idiopathic non-histaminergic angioedema
1. Hereditary angioedema (cannot be excluded without C1-INH level/function and C4 testing)
2. Periorbital lymphedema secondary to chronic facial rosacea
3. Early dermatomyositis with heliotrope rash and periorbital edema (would need CK, aldolase, and EMG/muscle biopsy to exclude)
